prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: unit-captive, one production battle sprite for an original dark-fantasy mercenary game, sprite-based 2.5D; final 512x512 square.
Input images: Image 1 unit-merc-sword.png and Image 2 unit-raider-axe.png are approved STYLE and SCALE references only. Create a new character, not a copy. Match their broad-brush black ink contours, coarse purposeful hatching, chunky dark shadow masses and muted earthy brown/taupe/grey wash, with the same anatomical proportions and readable game-scale detail. No glossy 3D, no smooth digital painting.
Subject: an exhausted adult mill worker in torn PLAIN clothes, a dirty unadorned linen shirt, worn trousers and humble work boots. Dust-streaked tired face, drooping shoulders, weary but standing upright enough to be readable. Both wrists bound together visibly with simple rope IN FRONT of the body. Head, gaze and torso face RIGHT. Unarmed, no armor, no military gear, no staff, no shield, no blade or tools. Clothing is ordinary patched workwear, not raider leather or a mercenary gambeson. No graphic injuries.
Composition: exactly one complete full-body standing figure. Fixed three-quarter top-down battle camera about 50 degrees downward, visible top surfaces, never eye-level, never flat side elevation. Human silhouette reaches approximately y=25 to y=485 on the final 512 canvas, similar scale to both references. Feet near bottom centre, ground anchor about x=256 y=480. Entire head, bound hands and boots inside canvas with clear padding. No crop, scenery, prison props, platform, base or drawn hex.
Background: perfectly flat uniform solid #00ff00 chroma-key green for local alpha removal. No green anywhere in the subject. Background has no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane or lighting variation. Opaque subject with crisp ink edges; no stray ink specks outside silhouette, no cast or contact shadow.
Constraints: original designs only; do not imitate any existing game, franchise character or artist. No text, logos, watermark, border, UI or extra characters. Deliver ONE separate square image, not a sheet or collage.
